programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en fotballspiller som blir straffet for å juble for mye, Jordan og Keegan som går på premieren på "Othello" og en high school-elev som blir berømt for å stjele en vits.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer gangstere som er gale etter 'Twilight,' besøk i en verden der navn er promper, og rasistiske superhelter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketsjer der Keegan og Jordan avlytter hvite kvinner som elsker svarte menn, Wendell lager en musikkvideo og Kareem og Jahar går på treningssenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klubb, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et intervju, Conrad flyr business class og Keegan har en ny bart.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: To gamle damer slåss mot Satan, ting går galt når en mann vil kjøpe en ny madrass og gjestene på en klubb tvinges til å se sannheten om seg selv.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer All-Stars fra East/West bowl som rapper, karene spiller mafioso og de to parkeringstypene har vanskelig for å tro at noen tør å provosere Batmans.
programme.sub-title: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan feirer Halloween med å flykte fra rasistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skremmende gjenforening, og vi besøker en folkeskole for trollmenn med problemer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Cunnilingus Class
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Mr. T lærer oss livsleksjoner, Wendell har bruk for en ny seng og en fornærmelse som går over streken.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Etter å ha prøvd å finne gutter på Facebook, bestemmer Abbi og Ilana seg for å prøve å finne gutter i 'virkeligheten'.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana prøver å tjene litt ekstra penger i 'temp game'. Abbi lover naboen sin å vente på pakken hans, men hun går glipp av leveransen og må dra til verdens ende for å få fatt i den.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Når Abbi får sprøytet leiligheten sin mot skadedyr og Ilana mister nøklene sine, blir jentene nødt til å bo på gaten - akkurat når Abbi har sin første kunstutstilling.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Når Abbi innser at hun er for snill, blir hun mere bitchy. Ilana bestemmer seg for å nå sitt fulle potential. De går på en eksklusiv fest og møter noen eventyrlige DJ-er. Nå kan ingenting gå galt.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana leter febrilsk etter en gave i siste øyeblikk til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver å finne et klimaanlegg for å få det kjølig på soveværelset.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Der dukker opp nye muligheter når Abbi endelig kan trene noen på Soulstice og Ilana gjør suksess som firmasjef.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi skal trekke visdomstennene og Ilana ser det som sin plikt å passe henne til hun får det bedre - noe som selvfølgelig innebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og en total mangel på tilsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi og Jeremy går på en date som ender med en overraskelse. Ilana og hennes mor leter etter den perfekte håndvesken.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Jentene leter etter den perfekte fest, noe som avslører en underlig og surrealistisk side av Abbi, som igjen bekrefter Ilanas verste anelser.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gjengen skal feire at Jaime har blitt amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers fører Abbi og Ilana på avveier med å love dem gratis sprit. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare seg selv blandt alle advokatene.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi prøver å finne en forsvunnet frakk, mens Ilana utforsker en ny romanse - som føles merkelig kjent.

programme.title: Broad City: St. Mark's
programme.desc: Når jentene feirer Ilanas 23. fødselsdag, blir de avbrudt av en rømt tenåring som fører dem ut på en vill jakt rundt i St. Mark's Place.

programme.title: Broad City: Two Chainz
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana opplever store klesuhell på vei til en venns utstilling og legger ut på en desperat jakt etter et offentlig toalett.

programme.title: Broad City: Co-Op
programme.desc: Abbi må late som om hun er Ilana for å ta hennes skift på jobben, mens Ilana drar til Long Island pga en svært viktig legetime.

programme.title: Broad City: Game Over
programme.desc: Ilana får en ny mulighet på Deals, Deals, Deals, og Abbi prøver å holde konkurranseinstinktet i sjakk på Soulstice Games Day.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack
programme.desc: Etter å ha mottatt en heftig regning for skadedyrsbekjempelse, holder Jaime og Ilana en fest for å dekke kostnadene. I mellomtiden drar Abbi ut på tokt for å møte nye mennesker.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana finner sitt nye kall, og Abbi må innom det mest fryktede sted i verden: biltilsynet.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for å besøke Abbis barndomshjem . Når Abbi innser at hun gjorde en stor tabbe på videregående, drar hun og Ilana på forsoningsoppdrag.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana legger ut leilighetene sine på B & B-NYC for å tjene litt ekstra penger.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas foreldre kommer til byen for deres 30-årsjubileum, men Abbi og Ilana syns det er vanskelig å feire når de begge opplever samlivsproblemer.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana skal ut på tur, men bare det å komme seg til flyplassen viser seg å være mye vanskeligere enn forventet.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbi får mensen under en flytur, så hun og Ilana går drastisk til verks for å finne en tampong.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: En vårdag i 2011 møtes Abbi og Ilana for første gang.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbis korte tilbakekomst til Soulstice blir interessant når hun får opplæringsmuligheten som hun alltid har drømt om. I mellomtiden får Ilana en ny jobb på en restaurant.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana går amok med pengene hun tjente på servitørjobben, og Abbis nye forhold gjør at det lyser av henne. På fest senere den kvelden, møter jentene på en gammel venn.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana ruser seg på sopp og opplever en hendelsesrik trip.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbis mor kommer til byen på besøk, og Ilana navigerer Sushi Mambeaux' intense arbeidskultur samtidig som hun håndterer sin sesongavhengig depresjon.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi føler seg gammel etter å ha funnet et grått hår; Ilana går til en sexterapeut.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot og Bobbi drar til Florida for å rydde ut av Grandma Esthers leilighet.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime og Lincoln passer huset til Strands. Ilana og Lincoln definerer forholdet deres, og Abbi går på en Bumble-date med en mann fra fortiden hennes.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: En fancy ny veske gir Abbi tillit under arbeidsledigheten. Ilana og Jaimé må ta tak i et uunngåelig New York City-mareritt.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Jentenes 'Friendiversary' utvikler seg i en farlig retning når de blir vitne til noe forferdelig.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana farer fra toppen av Manhattan til bunnen for å feire Abbis 30-årsdag, og treffer på både gamle og nye venner på veien.

programme.title: Broad City: Shework and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana gir seg i kast med sin seneste mulighet til å tjene penger da hun en åpner et utendørs kontorlandskap for New Yorks røykere; Abbi konfronterer husverten sin da han nekter å modernisere sanitæranlegget hennes.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana besøker en gammel flamme for å få sin del av en Bitcoin-formue; Abbi glemmer klesvasken sin for første gang, og mister favorittgenseren sin.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana oppdager en skremmende hemmelighet om Jaimé; Abbi prøver å avansere fra genserbretter til vinduskunstner på Anthropologie.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi inviteres til et fancy kunstarrangement på MoMA; Ilana og Lincoln analyserer det første året de har vært sammen.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 630
programme.desc: Daniel ser tilbake på alle de øyeblikkene som gjorde 2014 så forferdelig, ser inn i fremtiden med Doug Stanhope og kommer uanmeldt på en luguber forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Puke Drummer
programme.desc: I sesongpremieren av "Tosh.0" setter Daniel noen av årets mest hyllede film på plass, og han erklærer krig mot Super Bowl-vinnerne.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Buckcherry Wedding
programme.desc: En kvinne blir en giftig brud, Daniel introduserer S/M på arbeidsplassen og Arizona State University viser distraherende oppførsel.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Monster Energy
programme.desc: En gudfryktig kvinne fører en kampanje mot energidrikker, og Daniel avslører hvordan seerne kan bli rike ved bruk av pcen.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Shoenice
programme.desc: En loffer får en kjendisprofil, en ekkel kritiker får kritikk og Daniel gjør en innsats for å bekjempe rasisme i USA.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Jackie B.
programme.desc: Daniel lager en remix sammen med en rapgudinne, renser Internett bit for bit og skaper en ny hashtag for å styrke kvinner.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sting Wrestling Fan
programme.desc: Daniel slår et ærbødig slag for fribrytingens største fan, blir grillet av millioner av sine nærmeste venner og gjør all verdens gater trygge for motefolket.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Atheist In A Foxhole
programme.desc: Daniel profilerer en hedning i haltertopp, forteller om sitt eksklusive møte med en politiker fra Alaska, og skriver en sang til studentforeningsgutter som ikke er rasistisk, sjåvinistisk eller støtende.

programme.title: Tosh.0: RC Car
programme.desc: En radiostyrt bils nettoppreisning blir litt "Fast" og litt "Furious", "Tosh.0"-personalet spiser menneskemat og Daniel blir scientolog, kjendisenes offisielle religion.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sign Spinner
programme.desc: Daniel snakker med en tamburmajor som tjener minstelønn, hyller de modige menn og kvinner som bærer falske uniformer, og skjenker litt nødvendig fuktighet til California.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Girl Dunks
programme.desc: Daniel gir en Juwanna Mann-wannebee nettoppreisning, forvandler nedlatende homofobiske skjellsord til kvalitetsprodukter og møter en meget usedvanlig baby.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Microwave Glow Stick
programme.desc: Daniel gir en gutt som ikke er mikroovnsikker nettoprettelse, prøver å etterligne talkshows med dumme quizzer i stedet for å være morsom og gjør det gøy å sørge over sin elskede.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Fedora Hero Saves Eggs
programme.desc: Daniel løfter på hatten for en ydmykt skrytende helt, snakker med seg selv som tenåring og hjelper to usedvanlige mennesker med å finne hverandre.

programme.title: Tosh.0: High School Football Fan
programme.desc: Daniel profilerer et unikt high school-fotballfan, beviser at han er bedre enn alle andre og viser at løvblåsere kan være farlige hvis de ikke brukes korrekt.

programme.title: Tosh.0: How To Give A BJ
programme.desc: Daniel får oralsex-tips fra den minst lekre fyren på YouTube, introduserer en motstandsdyktig baby og avslører Hollywoods mest bedritne hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 715
programme.desc: Før Daniels sommerferie sjekker han inn hos Tosh.0-legendene, konfronterer sine mest irriterende fans og kommer med en erklæring som vil ryste filmindustrien i dets grunnvolder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Angelo Garcia, He-Man
programme.desc: Daniel lar oss møte en tidligere barnestjerne som kler seg ut som He-Man, viser at havrekjeks forvandler folk til løgnere og selger sine mest verdifulle eiendeler.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Welven Da Great
programme.desc: Daniel setter seg i sofaen med "Deez Nuts", Welven Da Great, og gjør det trygt for barn å spise sandwicher igjen...

programme.title: Tosh.0: Car Jump Kid
programme.desc: Daniel leker i trafikken med en amatør-stuntmann, finner ut om han fortsatt er den mest talenfulle i sin familie og deler noen fotballveddings-råd.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Annie Don't Fall
programme.desc: Daniel cruiser, deler rampelyset med publikum og lærer hvordan man beviser at man er klar for NFL.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Vegan Guy
programme.desc: Daniel får besøk av en vulgær vegansk sanger, snakker med en fyr som har for mye tid (å miste) og promoterer gode ereksjoner for alle.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Rifle Kid
programme.desc: Daniel tar en titt på våpenvolden, sørger for at det fins plasser å ansette sexy rekrutter til kontoret og viser hvorfor det alltid er bedre å spytte enn å svelge.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 'Ladies' Night: A Female Empowerment Episode'
programme.desc: Det er damenes aften og Daniel lovpriser alt kvinner elsker, inkludert sexy menn som kan danse, å vise følelser og i tillegg, kjendissladder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Kitten Play
programme.desc: Daniel hilser på en spesiell pus, demonstrerer de mest skremmende måtene man kan holde en iPhone, og det er debut på Amerikas kåteste nye lek.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 'Sword Nose'
programme.desc: Daniel krysser sverd med to av Mississippis fineste, beviser at en Internett-gærning i nød er en venn tross alt, og bruker saks for å få staben til å se noenlunde moteriktig ut.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Tosh.0 Memorabilia Auction #2
programme.desc: Det er Halloween, så i denne episoden av "Tosh.0" ser vi enda eklere videoer. Dessuten avslører Daniel resultatet fra sin auksjon og viser fram en kolleksjon knapt lovlige Halloween-drakter.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Elephant Lady
programme.desc: Daniel blir kunstnerisk med en særing, beviser at en 40 år gammel komiker kan være like sexy som en ung popstjerne, og snakker med de tristeste menneskene i verden: Detroit Lions-fans.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Catfish Cooley
programme.desc: Daniel lærer mer om Catfish Cooley, og avslører den beste måten å sluke en Georgia-fersken på.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 728

programme.title: Tosh.0: Arm Wrestle Break
programme.desc: Daniel gir en britisk "bird" med to brekte vinger en ny sjanse og spiser kake med nettets nyeste dessertdiva.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Tree Fall Kid
programme.desc: Daniel hjelper en kar å ta hevn på Moder Natur, deler ut Oscar for rasisme og bruker kondom for første og siste gang - alt dette mens han har på seg en bjørnefell.

programme.desc: Daniel hyrer juristen som er feministenes verste mareritt, blir kjent med landets mest gassfylte jente, og spriter opp tegngivingen for støtende ordbruk.

programme.desc: Daniel gir oppreisning til ei bikerdame som hoppet for nær solen (og ble brent), leker den eneste lek som gjør oss kvitt bigotteri og hat og viser det mest sexy siden noen viste brødene.

programme.title: Tosh.0: '7'

programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: South Park: Se opp for de selvgode!
programme.desc: South Parks innbyggere kjøper hybridbiler, men idet folk begynner å føle seg fornøyde fordi de redder verden, samler en mørk sky seg over byen.

programme.title: South Park: Kjærlighet, ikke Warcraft

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med toeren på pissoaret

programme.desc: Cartman fryser seg ned og våkner opp 500 år inn i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Lusningen

programme.title: South Park: De levende hjemløses natt
programme.desc: Uteliggere oversvømmer South Park, og guttene legger en lur plan for å flytte dem til en annen by, mens de voksne får panikk.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Utlogget
programme.desc: Forvirring og panikk råder da Internett blir borte i South Park!

programme.title: South Park: Pandemien
programme.desc: South Park tar en 'Cloverfield' med store, mystiske skapninger som herjer rundt i verden og blir fanget opp av Randys kamera.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemien 2: Alarmerende
programme.desc: Enorme marsvin angriper byer i hele verden. Guttene har nøkkelen til å redde menneskeheten, men sitter fast i Andesfjellene.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: I USA setter Top Gear-gutta kursen mot grensen til Mexico i en Lexus LFA, en Dodge Viper og en Aston Martin Vanquish.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James prøver å redde planeten ved å kjøpe hver sin elektriske bil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy får hjelp av noen kjendisvenner til å teste den nye Kia Cee'd, og F1-stjernen Lewis Hamilton er ukens kjendis i en billigbil.

programme.desc: Gutta tar en pause fra å sprenge campingvogner og drar på ferie, og Richard setter en lite imponerende verdensrekord i en F1-bil.

programme.desc: Tom Cruise og Cameron Diaz er ukens kjendiser i en billigbil, og James May forsøker å slå sin egen fartsrekord i en Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Teamet tar for seg et av verdens store ubesvarte spørsmål: Er det mulig å bygge en ekte amfibiebil som fungerer like godt til vanns som til lands?

programme.desc: En brutal tur til et nytt gruveområde skiller familien og presser Josh til bristepunktet.

programme.desc: Claudia gleder seg til å begynne driften i det nye området, men fremgangen stoppes etter en rekke uheldige hendelser på deres gamle gruveleir i Wolverine.

programme.desc: Små oppturer i leiren gleder et misfornøyd mannskap, og et overraskelsesbesøk bringer håp til Claudias fremtid på Two Mile.

programme.desc: Gary og Josh kommer ikke tilbake fra en rutinemessig drivstoffylling. Borere sår tvil om kvaliteten på jadelinsene på Two Mile.

programme.desc: Mens Guy og Gary desperat forsøker å fikse den ødelagte veien til stedet, håper Claudia at en ny medarbeider vil bringe den flaksen hun sårt trenger.

programme.desc: Claudia prøver å bevare freden når Robin og hennes far krangler, mens mannskapet sliter med å fikse det ene problemet etter det andre på gruvebilen deres.

programme.desc: Claudia presser mannskapet til å fortsette gruvedriften til tross for frysetemperaturer og stadig vanskeligere veiforhold.

programme.desc: Etter flere år med dårlige avtaler med Scrappy Larry lurer Robin sin gamle venn.

programme.title: Matlock: The Mistress
programme.desc: Matlock suffers a series of mishaps when he tries to find a missing murder witness to clear his client, who’s accused of killing her philandering husband.

programme.title: Matlock: The Dj
programme.desc: Matlock must overcome his dislike of a caustic radio personality and defend him when he is accused of killing a rival disk jockey.

programme.title: Matlock: The Captain
programme.desc: Matlock defends a patrolman framed for murder and is upset when he must investigate his longtime friend, the chief of police, as the prime murder suspect.

programme.title: Matlock: The Vendetta
programme.desc: Convinced that his brother was framed for murder, a psychopath is determined to get even and holds Matlock’s associates hostage.

programme.title: Matlock: The Mayor (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock uncovers unflattering secrets about the late mayor of Chicago while defending an aging hippie activist accused of the man’s assassination.

programme.title: Matlock: The Mayor (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s trip to the Windy City to defend a 1960’s radical accused of murdering Chicago’s mayor comes to a head in the second part of this dramatic two-part episode.

programme.title: Matlock: The Black Widow
programme.desc: Matlock takes the case of Ken Wilson, convicted of murdering his wife, whose body was never found. Recently released from prison after seven years, Wilson sets out to find his missing wife but gets arrested again.

programme.title: Matlock: The Other Woman
programme.desc: A disappearing diary, a missing mistress and a preposterous police report pose problems for Matlock when he agrees to defend a psychiatrist, Lucas Forbes.

programme.title: Matlock: The Psychic
programme.desc: Matlock defends a prominent psychic, Jennifer Holtz, who foresees her boyfriend’s murder and is subsequently arrested when he is found dead and Jennifer has no alibi.

programme.title: Matlock: The Thief (Part 1)
programme.desc: A rare-coin dealer invests his trust in Matlock when he’s accused of murdering an employee who was caught stealing valuable coins. Meanwhile, Tyler becomes disgruntled when Matlock hires another private investigator, Linda Hansfield, to work on the case.

programme.title: Matlock: The Thief (Part 2)
programme.desc: While defending a coin dealer accused of murdering an employee, Matlock and Tyler suspect the new investigator Ben hired, Linda Hansfield, is being blackmailed by the real kIller.

programme.title: Matlock: The Thoroughbred
programme.desc: A picturesque thoroughbred horse farm provides an unusual setting for murder when Ben Matlock defends a slow-witted stable hand, Tommy Jenks, accused of killing the stable owner’s daughter.

programme.title: Matlock: The Model
programme.desc: Ben Matlock defends a renowned journalist accused of murdering a beautiful international model. Matlock’s investigation is stalled when he is struck by a car and lands in the hospital with a slight case of amnesia.

programme.title: Matlock: The Cult
programme.desc: Matlock believes in the innocence of a man whose brainwashed son insists he saw his father kill the leader of his cult. Ben is the only hope left for a concerned father whose son, David, has been swept into a religious cult.

programme.title: Matlock: The Priest
programme.desc: A lawyer friend of Matlock’s puts his faith in the crafty attorney when his client is accused of killing a feisty priest, Father Fitzgerald.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness
programme.desc: Ben Matlock gives his assistant, Michelle Thomas, her toughest courtroom assignment... breaking down the eyewitness testimony of a former law classmate in a brutal murder case.

programme.title: Matlock: The Best Seller
programme.desc: District Attorney Julie March matches wits with tempestuous author Cynthia Slayton, whose torrid novels are suddenly eclipsed by facts surrounding the death of her best friend.

programme.title: Matlock: The Hunting Party (Part 1)
programme.desc: The serenity of historic Roanoke Island is shattered when a retired career soldier attempts to prove his late brother’s death was not a hunting accident, but murder.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med toeren på pissoaret
programme.desc: Cartman tror han vet hvem som står bak angrepene 11. september.

programme.title: South Park: Momben
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park forbereder seg til et besøk av Hillary Clinton. Cartman mistenker at en muslimsk elev er involvert i et mulig terroristangrep.

programme.title: South Park: Mer drittproblemer
programme.desc: Randy slår verdensrekorden 'største bæsj', og den tidligere rekordinnehaveren Bono vil ha tilbake tronen. Men han har en mørk hemmelighet som kanskje kan hindre ham.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nye stil
programme.desc: Mediesirkuset kommer til South Park når Britney gjemmer seg i den avsidesliggende fjellbyen. Guttene prøver å hjelpe den plagede popstjernen.

programme.title: South Park: Kina-problemet
programme.desc: Cartman blir forskrekket over den storslåtte OL-seremonien og ber Butters om hjelp til å konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig blir Stan og Kyle vitne til 'voldtekten' av Indiana Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kjendiser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøkelse nekter å akseptere å måtte vandre heden og etterlater resten av de nylig avdøde berømtheter frustrert i Skjærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Sexhjelpen
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinner seg midt blant Amerikas superkjendiser når de gjennomgår en behandling for sexavhengighet. Cartman og Stan er limt til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Kravene heves
programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy prøver å pare en av sine venninner med Butters, men hun ender opp på kontoret til skolekuratoren.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Fabuløs og modig
programme.desc: Gutta viser Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt store respekt i det mest fabuløse og modige 'South Park'-avsnittet noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Trygt sted
programme.desc: Cartman er siste offer innen kroppsskam.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye gutten i klassen overtaler Jesus til å kjempe mot Satan, i det endelige oppgjøret mellom godt og ondt. Cartman blir rasende når han oppdager at oppgjøret krasjer med bursdagsfesten hans.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Ring the bells! Spread the word! Latka Gravas and Simka Dahblitz are getting married, and the dingy Sunshine Cab Co. garage is transformed into a chapel of beauty for the social event of the cabbies' season.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The unflappable Jim gets an unexpected jolt when a wrecking ball crashes through the wall of his condemned apartment. A disaster ensues when he is forced to move in with Louie.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The drivers bare their souls, recalling those moments in their lives when fate caused them to detour from the street of dreams down the alley to becoming a cabbie.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: As Elaine nears a decision on her future, the cabbies reminisce about those glorious things that "might have been" had fate not sent them down that treacherous road to the Sunshine Cab Co.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Reverend Jim comes to the rescue when Alex is consumed by gambling fever after a lucky night in Atlantic City.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Simka learns that Latka has been unfaithful, she is bound by tradition to do the same thing with one of Latka's fellow cabbies.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: After Latka has an affair with a female cabbie, Simka must do the same with one of his co-workers.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”, the biggest aircraft in WWII.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer
programme.desc: I 1945 ble verden ført inn i atomalderen. Rollen hans som "Father of the Bomb" var satt , og Oppenheimer ble stadig mer bekymret for den potensielle faren denne vitenskapelige oppfinnelser kunne utgjøre for menneskeheten.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1964 Chevrolet impala and a 1957 Bel Air wagon. When the impala arrives, it is one step away from the junkyard. Due to a mistake in the shop, the restoration of the Bel Air goes further than intended.
programme.sub-title: 1964 Chevrolet Impala 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air Wagon

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working on a frame restoration on the 1972 Corvette. From Ugly to beautiful. The 59 Ford pickup truck is ready to go home to the owner. The 1964 Corvette Fuelie gets a new bumper.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Robby wants to convert a 1926 Ford Model T to a far rarer 1914 C Cab. Dan agrees to the plan, but soon has cause to regret it. Anthony buys a 69 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible, but the car of his dreams is an accident waiting to happen.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Grin and Bear a 'Cuda
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan's team take on the restorations of a 1966 Volkswagen Beetle and a 1976 TR6 convertible. The TR6 looks bad, but Dan sees hidden potential for it to become a rare 'survivor' car that still has its original paint and fixtures.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Brothers Jacob and Paul’s 1965 Chevy Impala nicknamed the Night Prowler would have been better named the Night Slug. Don shows up with a 1967 Corvette and a massive list of work that he wants done. Dan doesn’t know which is worse: the list, or the car.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas work on gluing the front panel on the 442 Restomod. This 67 Mercury Cougar has some issues with the rear brake pads.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Nick bought his wife Danielle a 1953 Chevy Pickup for her 28th birthday. The couple wants a perfect FantomWorks restoration. The truck has other ideas. Eric’s rare 1939 LaSalle is a sight to behold, but it hasn’t seen a wrench in eighty years.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: A 1977 Corvette Stingray arrives with seven layers of paint and too many problems to count. The restoration makes no sense, but Dan takes it. A 1965 Cobra is brought in for a simple wiring job. Then, the owner decides to wrap the car like a fighter jet.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Jay brings Dan a 2012 Camaro ZL1 with poor performance and a blown supercharger. Terry wants Dan to complete a high-powered restomod of a 1931 Landau Phaeton, but the car arrives with mismatched parts and an engine that should have stayed in the junkyard.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas take you on a tour of what is happening in the shop. Replacing the front end of a 64 Corvette resto mod. Painting racing stripes on a 67 442 convertible. A yellow Camaro underneath the hood of this car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dennis has always dreamed of owning the bright orange 1970 Shelby GT500 that kicked his ass in a drag race. Returning customer Rikk wants to get his rare 1970 Chrysler 300 Hurst in shape. But the car is plagued by a mystifying list of gremlins.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Ian wants a 1956 ‘baby bird’ restomod that drives like a sports car. Dan’s solution – a GTO-Thunderbird combo that drives like a bat out of hell. Doc Pellerin’s 1937 Volvo was a regular winner at Concours car shows – until a shelf fell on the car…

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Priviledge To Drive a '68 GTX Convertible
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.
programme.sub-title: Priviledge To Drive a '68 GTX Convertible

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: This Roadrunner gives me a Hemi
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.
programme.sub-title: This Roadrunner gives me a Hemi

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Mark Unwrapped
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: When Donnie decides that he wants to take his 1968 Fastback to SEMA, Dan and FantomWorks are thrown for a loop. Now, they need to get the Fastback and a 1964 Corvette to the prestigious show within a crushing time frame.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: In honor of wounded veterans, Dan and the team attempt a near-impossible conversion by making a 1970 Chevelle SS handicapped accessible. The shop's first pre-war restoration of a 1926 Velie with no manuals or parts takes them into uncharted territory.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike thought his 1967 Chevy K10 Pick Up needed paint improvement. Dan quickly realizes that the car needs much more. Nobody restores 1970 Opel Kadett, so there are no parts anywhere for Harry’s car that needs a lot of everything.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Japanese car culture holds a special place in Sung's heart. He's back exploring the home of drifting to see the coolest mods, and quirkiest characters. Sung finds that a quest for brilliance and excellence makes this the best place to get inspired.

programme.title: Snooker 900
programme.desc: Snooker 900 is the new fast, 15-minute version of snooker. It features legends like Jimmy White and showcases top amateurs, juniors, women, and disabled players.

programme.title: Trick Shot Cabaret
programme.desc: Enjoy a special Trick Shot Cabaret featuring 1985 World Champion Dennis Taylor, showcasing skill, flair and snooker entertainment.

programme.title: Snooker 900
programme.desc: Snooker 900 is the new fast, 15-minute version of snooker. It features legends like Jimmy White and showcases top amateurs, juniors, women, and disabled players.

programme.title: Dream Ticket Qualifier
programme.desc: Snooker 900 er den nye hurtige og spennende versjonen av spillet! Kom og se ukentlige konkurranser, arkiv spill, studio segmenter og mye mer.

programme.title: The Creator Clash
programme.desc: At the semi-final, Sara Guzo and Reanne Evans face Pieface23 and Dennis Taylor in the best of three frames.

programme.title: 900 Seconds with...
programme.desc: An exclusive interview looking back on Tony Knowles' career, his biggest matches, and memories from the snooker world.

programme.desc: Allison hlelper med å etterforske dødsfallet til en respektert forsamlingsmann, men av en eller annen grunn har hun visjoner om en ung gutt fanget i en brønn blandet med visjonene hennes om forsamlingsmannen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om et merkelig vennskap mellom to nylig myrdede spøkelser. Når hun prøver å hjelpe et av spøkelsene med å løse drapet hans, blir hun overrasket når han avslår hennes hjelp.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har visjoner om en voldelig far og hans unge sønn, som søker trøst fra smerten fra en snakkende dukke. Dukken kan imidlertid sende onde beskjeder til barnet.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Texas Ranger-kaptein Kenneth Push vender tilbake til Allisons liv når han har urovekkende visjoner om et drap i Phoenix.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison er besatt av en kvinne som heter Sandra... men Sandra virker fortsatt veldig levende.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har en drøm som finner sted omtrent 20 år i fremtiden der Marie dør av leukemi. Når Allison våkner er hun fast bestemt på å beskytte Marie uansett hva som må gjøres.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Den synske morderen fra "S.O.S." rømmer fra fengselet der Allison hjalp til med å sette ham og går etter Allison i hennes eget hus.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison etterforsker saken om en kvinnes myrdede ektemann. I mellomtiden får broren Michael en jobb som hotline-synsk, noe som fører til at han besøker en fortvilet klient i Arizona.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har tilbakevendende drømmer om at hun er ute i snøen, hvor hun til slutt finner et lik av en ung kvinne.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison fortsetter å drømme om en mann som dreper sin kone, selv etter at hun hjelper Devalos med å overbevise juryen om at den påståtte morderen er skyldig.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Etterforskningen av drapet på Walter Paxtons kone fortsetter, ettersom det nå er fastslått at en seriemorder er på frifot.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam glir stadig lenger unna Dana og familien sin når tvilen rundt slekskapet med Carrington-familien går innpå ham. Sarah Curtis fortsetter å forme et unaturlig bånd med Krystina.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sarah syr en kjole til Krystina som er identisk med en kjole datteren hennes hadde på seg. Sammy Jo og Steven gir etter for lidenskapen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven sliter med kjærligheten til Sammy Jo og legningen sin. Til tross for at hun blir advart om Dirk Mauriers tvilsomme forretningspraksis, inngår Alexis et partnerskap med ham.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex sendes på sykehuset i all hast, mens letemannskaper prøver å finne de savnede i Carrington-familien, som holdes fanget i en hytte.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Hendelsen i hytta gir Steven psykiske problemer. Politiet oppfordrer ham til å få hjelp med å takle traumet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven takker nei til Blakes ønske om å bli kampanjeleder. Adam blir sjokkert over at Dana ikke kan få barn. Alexis og Sean Rowan har en intim ettermiddag sammen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean takker ja til Alexis' jobbtilbud og blir umiddelbart uvenner med Adam. Dana plages av en hemmelighet fra fortiden som er forklaringen på at hun ikke kan få barn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis undergraver Blakes omdømme med en giftig lederartikkel i avisen sin. Danas entusiasme for å finne en surrogatmor falmer når hun mistenker at Adam synes den andre kvinnen er mer tiltrekkende.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En lidenskapelig helg får Alexis til å akseptere Seans impulsive frieri. Sammy Jo gir etter for Josh Harris' framstøt.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake ber Steven om å drive Denver-Carrington. Leslie lykkes i å forføre Jeff. Sammy Jo sliter; hun elsker Steven, men er tiltrukket av Josh.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis planlegger å hindre Dana i å adoptere Adams surrogatbarn. Adam informerer pressen anonymt om narkotikaproblemer på Stevens fotballag.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean truer Dana med utpressing hvis hun ikke hjelper ham med å grave fram inkriminerende opplysninger om Carrington-familien. Josh Harris blir knust da Sammy Jo sier nei til å gifte seg.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter møtet med Cora Van Husen, får Krystle en kopi av den skandaløse videoen som beviser at Blake er uskyldig.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter Josh Harris' død innser Sammy Jo at hun må gi slipp på Steven. Fallon blir opprørt av Stevens kompromissløse bruk av makt, og hun sklir lenger bort fra broren.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean utnytter Alexis' forsøk på å bli guvernør til å ta kontroll over Colbyco. Sammy Jo og Jeff er begge ensomme og utvikler et dypt vennskap. Dana forteller Adam at han var far til hennes aborterte barn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle får ødeleggende opplysninger om Alexis' ekteskap med Cecil Colby. Leslie følger etter Sean til farens grav og får vite at han egentlig er Joseph Aynders sønn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam og Fallon stemmer, og Steven må motvillig godta Vitron-oljehandelen, og Seans vanvittige plan for å hevne farens død settes i verk.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis får stor offentlig støtte etter skytingen, og det oppmuntrer henne til å fortsette valgkampen. Sean setter fortgang i planene om utnytte Vitron-handelen for å knuse Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean er lei av Leslies trusler om å avsløre hvem han egentlig er, og gjemmer en giftig slange på rommet hennes for å advare henne om hvem hun står overfor.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: 4400s across the world are coming down with strange and life threatening illnesses. Tom and Diana learn a horrible secret that the government may have directly caused the illnesses of the 4400s.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Discovering that NTAC is behind the disease plaguing the 4400s, Tom and Diana try to get to the bottom of NTAC's cover-up, while Kyle considers turning himself in.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana, with the help of Gary Navarro, try to track down T.J Kim, a 4400 whose ability they believe caused a man to stab Dennis Ryland. Richard and Lily are forced to deal with a now grown Isabelle.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro is arrested after attempting to assassinate Dennis Ryland. Isabelle attempts suicide in the hope of saving her mother, but fails when she survives a fall from the roof of the 4400 Center.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: T.J. Kim is murdered, and Tom is accused of committing the murder. Shawn and Isabelle grow closer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for someone who is kidnapping young 4400s. Shawn is threatened by the Nova Group.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: While in one of Alana's fantasies, Tom and Alana see Maia, though they have no memory of her existence. Diana's life is threatened, and Tom brokers a deal with the future to set history straight.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle seeks revenge on the Nova Group after they attack Shawn. Alana confronts the man responsible for killing her husband and son in a car accident nine years ago.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: With Dennis Ryland's help, NTAC tracks down the remaining members of the Nova Group. Nikki pays Shawn an unexpected visit.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are drugged with a hallucinogen, which was created from an oil secreted from the hands of a 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Kevin Burkhoff becomes a marked man when his research on promicin is discovered. Tom and Diana search for Kevin, but discover how far he will go to protect his work. Shawn meets his idol at the 4400 Center.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana's investigation into a series of gruesome murders leads them to uncover another conspiracy within the government. At the 4400 Center, Shawn receives a gift from another returnee that allows him to see his future.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC and the 4400 Center work together to find Jordan Collier. Kyle Baldwin gets a surprising visitor at the state prison.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Nova Group members that were in the custody of NTAC escape from jail with outside help from Jordan Collier. Diana tells April about her relationship with Ben. Shawn and Richard learn that Isabelle is working with Dennis Ryland.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dubbel hjelix
programme.desc: Andromeda blir inblandad i en fejd mellan en Than-planet och en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ängel mörk, demon ljus
programme.desc: En slipstream skickar Andromeda tillbaka i tiden till strax innan Samväldet faller. Besättningen måste ingripa för att bevara historien.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipsarna som förblindar
programme.desc: När besättningen svarar på ett nödsamtal hämtar de Bekas bror, som nu är Wayist, och hans vän.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bankerna i Lethe
programme.desc: Ett svart hål gör det möjligt för Dylan att kommunicera med sin före detta fästmö, 300 år tillbaka i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En ros i askan
programme.desc: Dylan är fängslad på en fängelseplanet och måste planera en flykt när hans besättning försöker göra sin egen räddning.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det stora Neptunus hav
programme.desc: Castalianer går ombord på Andromeda för att slutföra stadgan för det Nya Samväldet. När ledaren upptäcks död är Tyr den huvudmisstänkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pärlorna som var hans ögon
programme.desc: Beka får reda på att hennes fars tidigare affärspartner säljer en starkt beroendeframkallande drog som kallas Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårarnas matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda upptäcker sitt systerskepp Pax Magellanic. Besättningen ombord på Pax är 300 år gammal... men har inte åldrats en dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik från en avlägsen trumma
programme.desc: Tyr kraschlandar Eureka Maru på en Nietzscheansk planet och får minnesförlust. Han måste komma ihåg vad han gör innan nietzscheanerna upptäcker honom och hans låda med stöldgods.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper får kunskapens gåva från en döende perseid, men upptäcker att perseiden var eftersökt av en prisjägare som nu har riktat sin uppmärksamhet mot Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvångsperspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan arresteras för att ha mördat en diktator för 300 år sedan.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summan av dess delar
programme.desc: Andromeda bordas av en drönare från Consensus of Parts, ett mytiskt mekaniskt samhälle. Drönaren är vänlig till en början, men försöker tvinga skeppet att ansluta sig till Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skräck och avsky i Vintergatan
programme.desc: Gerentex är tillbaka och han kräver att Trance och Harper hjälper honom med sin nya plan: att hitta Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djävulen tar det sista
programme.desc: Dylan och Rev Bem hjälper ett fredligt samhälle att stå upp mot sina slavhandlare, men de måste vara försiktiga: om Dylan lär dem att döda kommer deras barn att födas med vetskap om det.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honungsoffer
programme.desc: Dylan försöker bringa fred mellan två olika Nietzscheanska stolta samhällen genom att eskortera prinsessan i det ena landet till sitt arrangerade bröllop med prinsen i det andra landet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjärnkorsad
programme.desc: Rommies avatar blir förälskad i vad som visar sig vara avataren av ett krigsfartyg som heter Gabriel. Gabriel försöker smitta Rommie med ett virus som sänder sina planer till krigsfartyget.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det är ett vackert ljus
programme.desc: Beka tar Andromeda till Tarn-Vedra, men en längre tid i slipstream orsakar biverkningar. För att bekämpa dem börjar Beka ta Flash och blir snart beroende.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dess timme har äntligen kommit
programme.desc: Ett gammalt minne från Andromeda aktiveras av misstag, vilket skickar henne på ett uppdrag och gör att Dylan och besättningen inte kan åsidosätta kommandot.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den växande strömmen
programme.desc: Dylan och Rommie måste rädda Tyr, Harper och Rev från Magogs världsskepp.

programme.title: Andromeda: Utgång strategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev och Tyr kraschlandar efter att ha undkommit ett gäng Nietzscheaner men ställs snart inför ett nytt hot: Revs behov för matning.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ett hjärta för falskhet Inramad
programme.desc: Besättningen måste stjäla en juvel som står i centrum för en fejd mellan en Drift-ägare och Than. Beka faller för en säkerhetschef som tidigare var tjuv.
